```{python}
#| label: g-estrategias
total_kev = int(df.in_kev.sum())
estrategias = {
    "CVSS ≥ 9":           df.cvss >= 9,
    "CVSS ≥ 7":           df.cvss >= 7,
    "EPSS ≥ 0.10":        df.epss >= 0.10,
    "EPSS ≥ 0.50":        df.epss >= 0.50,
    "KEV":                df.in_kev,
    "KEV ∪ EPSS ≥ 0.10":  df.in_kev | (df.epss >= 0.10),
}
res = pd.DataFrame([{
    "estrategia": nom,
    "arreglas": int(sel.sum()),
    "cobertura": df[sel].in_kev.sum() / total_kev * 100,
    "precision": df[sel].in_kev.mean() * 100,
} for nom, sel in estrategias.items()])

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    y=res.estrategia, x=res.arreglas, orientation="h",
    marker_color=ACCENT, text=[f"{v:,}" for v in res.arreglas],
    textposition="outside", textfont_color="#e6edf3"))
fig.update_layout(height=360, xaxis_title=L["estr_eje"],
                  xaxis=dict(type="log", range=[3, 5.55],
                             tickvals=[1000, 5000, 20000, 50000, 200000],
                             ticktext=["1k", "5k", "20k", "50k", "200k"]),
                  showlegend=False, margin=dict(l=150),
                  yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"))
fig.show()
```
